story:
[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan loved dinosaurs more than almost anything. One sunny afternoon, he went to the school's outdoor sandbox, where a sign said: *Dinosaur Dig Today![emotion:QT/shy] *

Ethan stopped near the edge. Another boy was already digging — carefully, slowly, using a small brush.

[emotion:QT/happy] "I'm Leo," the boy said, looking up with a wide smile. "I found something bumpy and brown. Do you want to help me figure out what it is?[emotion:QT/calm] "

Ethan stepped closer. "It looks like a long, flat bone," Ethan said, because he had studied dinosaur shapes for months.

[emotion:QT/surprised] "Whoa!" Leo said. "So that is why it curved like that!"

They took turns brushing away the sand — Ethan brushed, then Leo brushed — until a whole plastic T-Rex skeleton appeared beneath the surface.

[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt something warm and bright inside, like sunshine after a rainy morning.

[emotion:QT/happy] "We did it together," Leo said, grinning.

[emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:hoora] Ethan grinned back. "We really did."

questions.question: Where did Ethan go one sunny afternoon?
questions.correct_answer: He went to the school's outdoor sandbox.
wrong_answers: He went to the big park.

questions.question: What did Ethan and Leo find together in the sandbox?
questions.correct_answer: They found a whole plastic T-Rex skeleton.
wrong_answers: They found a small toy car.

questions.question: Why did Ethan know the bumpy brown thing was a bone when Leo found it?
questions.correct_answer: Ethan knew it was a bone because he studied dinosaur shapes.
wrong_answers: He knew it was a bone because Leo told him.
He knew it was a bone because it was very big.

questions.question: How do you think Ethan felt when Leo asked him to help dig?
questions.correct_answer: Ethan felt happy and maybe a little less shy.
wrong_answers: Ethan felt tired and wanted to go home.

questions.question: What was this story mostly about?
questions.correct_answer: This story was about two boys who found a dinosaur together.
wrong_answers: This story was about a boy who loved to run.
This story was about a school trip.

takeaways: Working together with a friend helps you do things you cannot do alone.
Being brave enough to take one small step toward someone new can start a real friendship.
Sharing what you know is a kind and generous thing to do.
